content.title: When Does Invincible Season 4 Drop on Prime Video?
content.text: Fans didn’t have to wait very long for Invincible to come back for season 4. Sam Connon breaks down everything you need to know before the animated superhero sensation returns. When Invincible made its debut on Amazon Prime Video back in 2021, fans had to wait a grueling two-and-a-half years for the much-anticipated season 2. And even when the series returned, it took a midseason break that put the story on hold for an additional four months. Those days seem to be behind us, though, with season 3 coming out after just 10 months off and season 4 now slated to premiere 12 months later. If you are waiting with bated breath to see what happens next in the violent, animated superhero TV show, here is everything you need to know before season 4 comes out: When does Invincible season 4 come out? Season 4 will premiere on Amazon Prime Video on Wednesday, March 18. As was the case with the first three seasons, Invincible season 4 will drop its first three episodes all at once. The episodes are titled Making the World a Better Place, I’ll Give You the Grand Tour and Making the World a Better Place. They are expected to have a runtime around 50 minutes each. The fourth season will consist of eight episodes total. After the three-episode premiere, one episode will come out per week until the finale on April 22. (Warning: Spoilers for Invincible seasons 1-3 ahead.) Who will show up this season? The ensemble cast of Invincible is among the most expansive in all of television. On top of all the returning voice actors, a handful of fresh faces are coming over from the comics for their animated debuts. Here is a brief look at who is confirmed to be in the cast for season 4: Steven Yeun as Mark Grayson a.k.a. Invincible J.K. Simmons as Nolan Grayson a.k.a. Omni-Man Sandra Oh as Debbie Grayson Christian Convery as Oliver Grayson a.k.a. Young Omni-Man Gillian Jacobs as Samantha Eve Wilkins a.k.a. Atom Eve Andrew Rannells as William Clockwell Walton Goggins as Cecil Stedman Chris Diamantopoulos as Donald Ferguson Seth Rogen as Allen the Alien Tatiana Maslany as Telia Peter Cullen as Thaedus Michael Dorn as Trokk a.k.a. Battle Beast Zachary Quinto as Robot Ben Schwartz as Shapesmith Khary Payton as Markus Grimshaw a.k.a. Black Samson Jay Pharoah as Zandale Randolph a.k.a. Bulletproof Ross Marquand as Immortal & Rex (formerly Rudy) Grey DeLisle as Shrinking Rae & Monster Girl Clancy Brown as Damien Darkblood & Kregg Jeffrey Dean Morgan as Conquest Lee Pace as Thragg Matthew Rhys as Dinosaurus Danai Gurira as Universa Djimon Hounsou as Space Racer What to expect in Invincible season 4 Earth is still reeling after the onslaught of massive battles in season 3, from PowerPlex’s rampage to the Invincible War and Conquest’s arrival. Rex Splode was one of the few major characters who didn’t make it out alive, while Eve went from the verge of death to as powerful as ever. Still, Mark and Eve didn’t even kill Conquest, who the GDA captured an kept in a coma. Angstrom Levy is alive, too, after rallying an army of evil Invincibles to wreak havoc – even if the alternate universe portal-maker is now a pawn for the mysterious Technicians. To make matters worse, Damien Darkblood is also plotting something in Hell. The Viltrum Empire is preparing to invade Earth, as well, with solo Viltrumites already causing more than enough damage on their own. Mark, Eve and Oliver will need all the help they can get, which could come in the form of Allen the Alien and Omni-Man himself. After all, Nolan revealed last season that there are only about 50 true Viltrumites left, so raising a force to fight them may not be impossible after all. The Guardians of the Globe, Battle Beast and another rebel Viltrumite, Thaedus, are on their side of the war, too, not to mention to Coalition. In the season 4 trailer, we see Allen and Nolan on Earth asking for Mark’s help. Eve also seems to be struggling with her powers, which we learned more about in the standalone Atom Eve prequel episode from 2023. Invasions and space battles won’t be in short supply, either. And on top of all of that, Mark will be donning his original yellow and blue costume again. Watch the full Invincible season 4 trailer below: Invincible FAQs When does Invincible season 4 come out? The first three episodes of Invincible season 4 will premiere on Wednesday, March 18. Where can I watch Invincible? Season 4 will be available to stream on Amazon Prime Video. Seasons 1 through 3 are also on Prime Video if you are looking to catch up. Will there be another season of Invincible? Amazon publicly renewed Invincible for a fifth season in July 2025. Going by the show’s recent schedule, season 5 could air as soon as early 2027.
